name: status line: bold red ERR at row 3, keystroke echoed, early lines in scrollback
command:
import sys
s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
w = sys.stdout.write
w('\x1b[2J\x1b[H')
for i in range(1, 9):
    w('row %d\r\n' % i)
w('\x1b[2J\x1b[H')
w('\x1b[3;5H')
w('\x1b[1;31mERR\x1b[0m')
w('\x1b[5;1Hstatus: ' + s)
sys.stdout.flush()
